Why? There's nothing in the movement code that's different between MV and MZ, there's nothing to convert. However, it doesn't do what the OP's asking.
TheRamenGirl said:
i need a plugin to make the sprites move like this (by the way i use big sprites and
turn in place
plugin if it matters)
Click to expand...
I find your description slightly confusing, as it seems to me that using a turn in place plugin contradicts what that GIF looks like - it does
not
turn in place, it starts moving as it's turning to face the new direction.
I think that's pretty ugly, but I made a plugin that does what you described as your request. It should replace any other turn in place plugin you were using, and it will make the player turn 90 degrees at a time until it's facing the new direction.
Rotate Move (MV/MZ)
Rotate Movement 1.0 ATT_Turan  Introduction This plugin, based on a request by @TheRamenGirl, forces the player character to be facing the desired direction before it can start walking. It combines two features - one is that tapping a direction key will make the player turn in place. Unlike...
